findings.title: select().all() returns tuples, breaks .in_() filter
findings.problem: session.exec(select(Budget.budget_id).where(...)).all() returns a list of Row tuples [(id1,), (id2,)], not scalar strings. When passed to .in_(budget_ids), the SQL WHERE Budget.budget_id.in_([(id,)]) will fail to match or error.
findings.impact: The update to nullify project_name on soft-deleted budgets will not execute correctly, leaving FK references intact. Project deletion will fail with FK violation, breaking the core fix.

findings.title: Commit format violates EPMCDME-####: convention
findings.problem: 4 commits in this change use task-slug prefix format (fix-project-deletion-fk-violation: ..., budget-assignment-record-spending: ...) instead of the required EPMCDME-####: Description format specified in git-workflow.md.
findings.impact: Breaks commit format convention, preventing traceability to Jira work items and disrupting consistent git history navigation.
findings.recommendation: Rebase or squash-merge to a single commit with EPMCDME-13156: format before merging
